description: Donor-phase scope gate. Active opportunity analysis, ranking and queue planning use ONLY the DS donor set. GBA/GBC donor findings are preserved verbatim in opportunities/deferred/non_ds_findings.json and are NOT loaded by the register, queue or rankings until the next phase.
rules: an active finding's donor.source_id must be a ds_sources key other than platinum
an active finding's donor.game/locator must not name a deferred game as a donor
the deferred file must exist, hold only non-DS findings with phase=deferred_gba_gbc, and is never read by build_opportunities.py or build_queue.py
existing ledgers/catalog are DS-only already (sources: hgss, diamond, pmd_sky, ranger2)
